title: Phoenician masons build Solomon's temple

tellings.quote: the Hyram of Ty the king and Hyram Abif his his premier artificer um that's who built the temple

plain: The temple of the Bible's King Solomon in Jerusalem was built by Phoenicians, a seafaring people of the ancient Near East: Hiram, king of their city of Tyre, and his master craftsman, Hiram Abiff. A researcher named Tim Alberino tells this on Michels's show, calling Hiram Abiff the king's "premier artificer" and saying, "that's who built the temple."
